theme: An open day, with Florida logistics waiting to be locked.
greeting: The calendar's clear today, Dan — nothing between you and the water. The only real pull is a small cluster of Florida-trip bookings that want settling before you land on the 20th.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: The p1 Portland booking slipped a day past due. A full-size SUV over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and sells out early — a refundable hold now takes the whole risk off the table.

needsAttention.title: Rental car for the Florida arrival
needsAttention.detail: Sept 20 - Oct 5 full-size SUV out of TPA is still unbooked. You land Sunday the 20th; better to have it locked than face walk-up rates jet-lagged on a Sunday.

needsAttention.title: St Pete landing-gap lodging
needsAttention.detail: Sept 20-21 in the St Pete area is still unbooked, the gap before the kids' Tuesday pickup on the 22nd.

needsAttention.title: NACD New England programming call
needsAttention.detail: The committee meets tomorrow at 1 PM ET on Zoom - worth arriving with a couple of thoughts on the fall program slate.

inbox.noise: The inbox is all newsletters and retail - AAdvantage, Resy, Folio, Responsible Investor, NYT Cooking.
inbox.clear: Nothing is waiting on your reply.

recipe.title: Borlotti beans with sautéed baby kale
recipe.why: Autumn leans into hardy greens and fresh-shell beans — a slow, earthy pot for the turning season.

tasks.title: Lock Disney tickets for the Orlando weekend
Check for a better St Pete Airbnb before the charge

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar - the morning is entirely yours.
Still clear; the Florida-trip bookings are the only thing tugging at the day.
Tomorrow opens with the NACD programming call at 1 - a few thoughts on the fall slate are worth carrying in.
